text:
Taylor: Heads-up: OKR deck v3 ready for final pass. Need alignment on two tradeoffs before Priya's review at 15:00 — (1) priority: Dedicated capacity features (autoscaling + burst) vs Private networking controls; (2) launch metric: lead metric = latency p95 250ms OR unit cost <= $0.002. Pick a lead metric so execs have a single north star.
Anja: I lean latency as the lead. Dedicated customers care about tail latency. But note: making latency the lead pushes infra work and could impact the ramp.
Ravi: Agree on latency. Practically, if we pin quantization and optimizer suggestions we can later chase cost. Implementation risk: Dedicated autoscale (full) requires infra changes — estimate ~6 weeks with 2 engineers.
Priya: Latency lead makes sense. Also want an explicit migration path for cost. Call out customers A and B who are blockers if we don't meet cost in Q. We need a fallback policy in the rollout notes.
Lina: Proposal: Lead metric = latency p95 250ms; include cost as a guardrail: unit cost <= $0.002 with a note "target to be met within 2 quarters" so it's visible but not the immediate showstopper.
Zoe: UX ask: include wording in launch criteria about "no UI regressions" and a default degraded-mode experience when fallback triggers. I'll attach a short checklist to the deck.
Taylor: Added Lina's phrasing and Zoe's checklist placeholder. Flagging Dedicated autoscale as an implementation risk/blocker for Q ramp. @Ravi can you confirm the 6-week estimate? If yes we need to either cut scope for launch or slide ramp.
Ravi: Confirmed — 6 weeks for autoscale-full with 2 senior engs. Alternative: ship autoscale-lite (no burst support, simpler policy) in ~3 weeks and iterate to full autoscale post-launch.
Taylor: OK decision: ship autoscale-lite for the Q launch, keep autoscale-full in backlog and schedule for post-launch sprint. Lead metric set to latency p95 250ms; cost guardrail $0.002 target over 2 quarters. I'll update the deck and send to Priya. @okrs-bot please record the decision.
okrs-bot: Recorded decision: Lead metric=latency p95 250ms; Cost guardrail=$0.002 (target within 2 quarters); Autoscale-lite for Q launch; Full autoscale in backlog. Entry added to decisions.log.
Priya: :thumbsup: Good. Please circulate the final deck 30 minutes before review and include a 1-slide risk mitigation plan.
Taylor: Will do — circulating in 25.
